listing.name: Onslaught Sleek
listing.summary: A mod made by me and <@142370041839484928> ,with the sprite provided by <@312119593089105921> we present Onslaught sleek a prototype Hegemony Onslaught that was never supposed to see production besides for a test demonstration! It now circulates through merc fleets and markets but at a very rare chance so be on the lookout in them markets and possibly take a shot at the merc fleet to try out this baby for yourself!
listing.aiSummary: Adds a rare prototype Hegemony Onslaught ship found in mercenary fleets and markets.

description:
A mod made by me and @joebob73 on discord, with the sprite provided by @Moosin reddit name Moosin_Pyrett "Full permission was given to use sprite.

We present Onslaught sleek a prototype Hegemony Onslaught that was never supposed to see production besides for a test demonstration! It now circulates through merc fleets and markets but at a very rare chance so be on the lookout in them markets and possibly take a shot at the merc fleet to try out this baby for yourself!

but beware the mercs weren't the only ones to get ahold of this prototype....face a terrifying bounty fleet and claim it for yourself? or let it roam causing chaos to pathers mercs and explorers alike!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/17oNhU_tC0gs-jFBFoFdKsSRGIqUJNez6/view?usp=sharing

Version 1.2 Update: Fixed Crash issue involving the stabilized shield emitter thanks to KWHWWYMWN on the starsector discord! Version 1.2 IS save compatible we fixed it
